summary: Scope review for iteration `customer-feedback-form` succeeded. The current planned stories, elaborated requirements, and test design are consistent with the delivery objective: public `/feedback/{identifier}` resolution, safe handling for malformed/unknown links, 30-day expiry, unauthenticated customer form display with product name and purchase date, 1-10 rating, required feedback message up to 200 characters, server-side validation, update of the existing `Feedback` row only, and read-only display for repeat visits after submission. Technical readiness is acceptable: prerequisite `feedback-request-batch-upload` is approved and source evidence shows `FeedbackBatch`/`Feedback` models with unique `linkIdentifier`, `productName`, `purchaseDate`, nullable `rating`, nullable `feedbackMessage`, and `submittedAt`; request emails already use the `/feedback/{linkIdentifier}` URL contract. Current source has no public `src/app/feedback` route yet, which is expected delivery work, not a blocker. Checks passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm.cmd run lint`. Browser verification, Playwright/e2e tests, app server startup, production build, deployment, publishing, and real email/customer contact were not run per task constraints.
